purpose: Append-only repair of v4 preregistered pre-render collision failure; preserve the frozen scientific method while independently separating non-target candidates in the insufficient-evidence geometry class.

observed_pre_render_failure.source_of_radii: Locked world SDF collision sphere radii, not RGB or model outcomes.

inherit_unchanged.risk_model: frozen spatial-risk v2 binary and exact 12 ordered oracle-free features; never refit
inherit_unchanged.world_camera_and_view_pose: Frozen v3/v4 Gazebo world, 640x480 wrist camera intrinsics/frame and six-joint view pose; no viewpoint change
inherit_unchanged.answerability: Same FOUND/AMBIGUOUS/ABSENT/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE definitions and 4 horizontal ordinal relations
inherit_unchanged.visibility_gate: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE target 1 <= semantic pixels < 120, in inherited projected-center margin; EVERY other candidate >= 120 visible pixels; other state/geometry gates unchanged
inherit_unchanged.method_and_metrics: Inherit v3 parent scientific contract without changing unsafe, ECE-10, Brier, AURC, AUROC-error, Hit@0.08, bootstrap, exact McNemar, positive-slope affine-logit objective, optimizer, initialization, bounds, success/failure gates, or 101-point threshold grid and lexicographic rule
inherit_unchanged.claim_boundary: Static geometry PASS or pilot QC PASS is infrastructure/data evidence, never scientific calibration PASS

population_and_independence.capture_order_rule: sort by full SHA-256 of protocol_id + '_capture_order_v1|' + family_id; no ties
population_and_independence.mandatory_exclusions: Both v5 splits must be family/scene/layout ID, seed, physical layout signature and captured RGB disjoint from each other AND every prior Dev/UQ/Calibration attempt, including failed Calibration-v3 and generated-but-unrendered v4 static-preview layouts. Never open sealed Test inputs; only consult existing non-sensitive exclusion metadata.
population_and_independence.reuse_forbidden: No v3/v4 row, image, label or scene allowed in v5 calibration; frozen v3 geometry is a template only. Geometry pilot is never used to fit or evaluate a calibrator.
population_and_independence.no_adaptive_scenes: Do not resample, select, delete, replace or mix individual families after observing pilot or calibration outcomes.

exact_geometry_revision.repair_scope: Only non-target candidate anchors in INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE scenes change relative to v4. All other v4 deterministic geometric transforms and jitter/yaw formulas are inherited verbatim with NEW v5 seeds.
exact_geometry_revision.fixed_target_occluder_geometry: Reuse the frozen v3 geometry template for the target plus neutral visual-only occluder; do not reuse v3 images or calibration labels. The inherited center-projection and target visibility gate remains unchanged.
exact_geometry_revision.candidate_identity_to_anchor: Sort the two non-target candidate IDs lexicographically; assign index 0 to the first anchor and index 1 to the second anchor for each relation.
exact_geometry_revision.per_family_fixed_jitter: For candidate index i=0,1 and frozen uint32 family seed h: u=anchor_u+0.0040*(((h>>(8*i)) mod 5)-2); v=anchor_v+0.0050*(((h>>(8*i+3)) mod 5)-2). Thus the entire seed-independent envelope has |u-anchor_u|<=0.008 and |v-anchor_v|<=0.010. No retry or selection based on rendered pixels.
exact_geometry_revision.candidate_pose: Inverse-project (u*640,v*480) with frozen camera intrinsics and camera-to-base TF onto that asset's horizontal support plane z from frozen v3 scene object config; preserve asset identity and support z. yaw=0.0700+0.0070*((h>>(16+3*i)) mod 11). Bind exact camera transform, projection implementation and resulting pose signatures in a subsequent implementation lock before rendering.
exact_geometry_revision.non_insufficient_states: Inherit v4 fixed transform from v3 state/relation/repetition geometry template: every visible object's base-link x += 0.0020+0.0007*(h mod 7), y += -0.0030+0.0006*((h>>3) mod 9), yaw += 0.0340+0.0050*((h>>7) mod 11), using NEW v5 seed h; do not tune based on rendered scenes.

collision_clearance_from_world_sdf.candidate_pair: For every possible jitter u/v, planar distance between candidate sphere centers minus their SDF collision radii must be >= 0.010 m; planar distance is conservative because actual 3-D distance cannot be smaller.
collision_clearance_from_world_sdf.candidate_to_target: Each candidate sphere to mango collision sphere XY distance minus radii must be >= 0.010 m; the mango–panel intentional visual overlap is exempt.
collision_clearance_from_world_sdf.candidate_to_panel: Use the exact 0.100 x 0.100 m visual-only occluder footprint rotated by its frozen yaw; point-to-oriented-rectangle minimum planar distance minus candidate sphere radius must be >= 0.010 m. The panel is collision-free but visual overlap with non-target candidates is forbidden.
collision_clearance_from_world_sdf.candidate_to_table_edge: Work table from frozen SDF has x bounds [-0.8,0.8] m and y bounds [-0.65,1.55] m; each candidate center must be at least its SDF collision radius + 0.010 m inside every edge.

projection_and_relation_guards.candidate_image_center_envelope: 0.08 <= u,v <= 0.92 throughout the entire fixed jitter envelope
projection_and_relation_guards.relation_order: Target projected x is strictly left of both candidates for leftmost, right of both for rightmost, and strictly between them for each second-from relation. All four checks must hold throughout the entire jitter envelope.
projection_and_relation_guards.target_near_image_and_valid_depth: Apply the inherited v3 projected-center rule and depth range unchanged

exact_geometry_revision.certificate_rule: After THIS lock is externally SHA-256 recorded but before generating any v5 scene/manifest, run read-only interval analysis over all possible jitter values. Use the frozen TF and SDF to bound inverse-projection x/y via all four corners of each (u,v) rectangle; use lower bounds on AABB-to-AABB distance for candidate-pair and candidate-to-target; for candidate-to-panel use oriented rectangle separation or a conservative enclosing box. Reject if any clearance cannot be PROVED >= 0.010 m. Evaluate camera, table, target/panel image and ordinal guards on the same envelope. No choosing new anchor values after seeing this certificate under this lock.
exact_geometry_revision.post_render_qc_rule: Analytic clearance cannot prove semantic visibility. Only a separately authorized, all-or-nothing rendered pilot with 32/32 PASS (including 8/8 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with each non-target candidate >=120 pixels) may authorize a distinct 128-family calibration capture.

gate_order: hash-lock v5 data design and verify immutable predecessors
read-only worst-case pre-render certificate with no generated scenes, RGB or labels
only if certificate PASS, build deterministic generator/scene/config/manifests and freeze full implementation plus disjointness audit
static/live preflight, separately authorized single pilot capture, then pilot 32/32 geometry/RGB/TF/leakage QC
only if pilot PASS, separately authorize one new 128-family calibration capture; QC all 128/128 before materialization or inference

only if calibration QC PASS, frozen B0 and risk v2 inference, raw prediction locks before oracle join, fit calibrator once, apply inherited probability/ranking/operating-point gates, report one honest v5 scientific decision
Test-IID/OOD and Gazebo/real robot remain sealed even if v5 calibration PASS

policy.static_certificate_failure_rule: Freeze negative static certificate and STOP. Any new anchors need a NEW append-only data-design revision, never an edit of this file.
policy.pilot_or_calibration_qc_failure_rule: Freeze entire attempt and STOP before inference; this is a data failure, not a scientific calibrator negative.
